0.0: I keep hearing all kinds of obnoxious bangs and scratches coming from lower down in Orbis Tower, and it's wreaking havoc on my concentration. I'll never complete my research at this rate.
0.1: The monster population is getting out of control again. Would you help me out by trimming their numbers a bit?

yes.0: Thanks! You'll find the monsters on Orbis Tower's 8th Floor.

no.0: Hm, well I need to finish my research before I can head back to town. Come to me again if you change your mind.

1.0: Ah! My greatest friends, Peace and Quiet. Ha ha!\r\nMy research should progress nicely now. Thank you!

yes.0: Go to El Nath if you're not sure where to go next.\r\nI heard there are people over there that need help.

default.0: Did you take care of those monsters? It's still awfully noisy.
